arxiv-2204-04646.title: Deep Embeddings for Robust User-Based Amateur Vocal Percussion Classification
arxiv-2204-04646.description: Abstract Vocal Percussion Transcription (VPT) is concerned with the automatic detection and classification of vocal percussion sound events, allowing music creators and producers to sketch drum lines on the fly. Classifier algorithms in VPT systems learn best from small user-specific datasets, which usually restrict modelling to small input feature sets to avoid data overfitting.

arxiv-2404-08424.title: Comparing Apples to Oranges: LLM-powered Multimodal Intention Prediction in an Object Categorization Task
arxiv-2404-08424.creator: Hassan Ali, Philipp Allgeuer, Stefan Wermter
arxiv-2404-08424.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hassan Ali, Philipp Allgeuer, Stefan Wermter. Human intention-based systems enable robots to perceive and interpret user actions to interact with humans and adapt to their behavior proactively. Therefore, intention prediction is pivotal in creating a natural interaction with social robots in human-designed environments. In this paper, we examine using Large Language Models (LLMs) to infer human intention in a collaborative object categorization task with a physical robot.

arxiv-2409-11184.title: LASERS: LAtent Space Encoding for Representations with Sparsity for Generative Modeling
arxiv-2409-11184.creator: Xin Li, Anand D. Sarwate
arxiv-2409-11184.description: Abstract Learning compact and meaningful latent space representations has been shown to be very useful in generative modeling tasks for visual data. One particular example is applying Vector Quantization (VQ) in variational autoencoders (VQ-VAEs, VQ-GANs, etc.), which has demonstrated state-of-the-art performance in many modern generative modeling applications.

arxiv-2501-09672.title: CHIRP: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Open-Ended Response Evaluation in Vision-Language Models
arxiv-2501-09672.creator: Alexis Roger, Prateek Humane, Daniel Z. Kaplan, Kshitij Gupta, Qi Sun, George Adamopoulos, Jonathan Siu Chi Lim, Quentin Anthony, Edwin Fennell, Irina Rish, *Equal contribution, Mila - Quebec AI Institute, Université de Montréal, realiz.ai
arxiv-2501-09672.description: Abstract The proliferation of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in the past several years calls for rigorous and comprehensive evaluation methods and benchmarks. This work analyzes existing VLM evaluation techniques, including automated metrics, AI-based assessments, and human evaluations across diverse tasks. We test our model on a scaling suite across vision and langauge sizes, identifiying shortcomings of current evaluation approaches.

pmc-11293162.creator: Erika FJORDKVIST, Maria HÄLLEBERG NYMAN, Madeleine WINBERG, Eva JOELSSON-ALM, Ann Catrine ELDH
pmc-11293162.description: BackgroundFirst-line managers have a unique role and potential in encouraging the use of evidence-based clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) and thus serve the provision of safe patient care. pmc-11356232.title: A Large-Scan-Range Electrothermal Micromirror Integrated with Thermal Convection-Based Position Sensors
pmc-11356232.creator: Anrun Ren, Yingtao Ding, Hengzhang Yang, Teng Pan, Ziyue Zhang, Huikai Xie, Sabina Merlo
pmc-11356232.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This paper presents the design, simulation, fabrication, and characterization of a novel large-scan-range electrothermal micromirror integrated with a pair of position sensors. Note that the micromirror and the sensors can be manufactured within a single MEMS process flow. Thanks to the precise control of the fabrication of the grid-based large-size Al/SiO2 bimorph actuators, the maximum piston displacement and optical scan angle of the micromirror reach 370 μm and 36° at only 6 Vdc, respectively.

pmc-11359246.title: General Relations between Stress Fluctuations and Viscoelasticity in Amorphous Polymer and Glass-Forming Systems
pmc-11359246.creator: Alexander Semenov, Jörg Baschnagel
pmc-11359246.description: Mechanical stress governs the dynamics of viscoelastic polymer systems and supercooled glass-forming fluids. It was recently established that liquids with long terminal relaxation times are characterized by transiently frozen stress fields, which, moreover, exhibit long-range correlations contributing to the dynamically heterogeneous nature of such systems.

pmc-12732862.title: Soloxolone N-3-(Dimethylamino)propylamide Suppresses Tumor Growth and Mitigates Doxorubicin-Induced Hepatotoxicity in RLS40 Lymphosarcoma-Bearing Mice
pmc-12732862.creator: Arseny D Moralev, Aleksandra V Sen’kova, Alina A Firsova, Daria E Solomina, Artem D Rogachev, Oksana V Salomatina, Nariman F Salakhutdinov, Marina A Zenkova, Andrey V Markov, Luminita Crisan, Alina Bora
pmc-12732862.description: Multidrug resistance (MDR) remains a significant obstacle to effective cancer chemotherapy, primarily due to overexpression of P-glycoprotein (P-gp), which reduces intracellular accumulation of cytotoxic drugs. This study evaluated the pharmacological potential of the glycyrrhetinic acid derivative soloxolone N-3-(dimethylamino)propylamide (Sol-DMAP) as a biocompatible P-gp inhibitor with hepatoprotective properties.

pmc-12801483.title: Food allergy knowledge and attitudes among university students in Palestine: a cross-sectional study of determinants and educational needs
pmc-12801483.creator: Ruaa Sleimieh, Fadwa Nasri, Hidaya Ibrahim, Dania Abuhalima, Muna Shakhshir, Sari Taha, Banan M Aiesh, Samah W Al-Jabi, Sa’ed H Zyoud
pmc-12801483.description: BackgroundFood allergy (FA) is an immune-mediated reaction that can cause anything from minor symptoms such as skin rashes to severe, potentially fatal anaphylaxis. Little is known about FA knowledge and management among Palestinian university students, despite the abundance of studies on the condition in pediatric populations.

pmc-13005965.title: Mixed-Methods Evaluation of Programmatic Interventions on Academic Performance and Resident Perspectives in Internal Medicine Residency
pmc-13005965.creator: Abdullah M Al Alawi, Salim Al Busaidi, Masoud Kashoub, Ghadeer Al Sarmi, Ibrahim S Al-Busaidi, Nujood Abdullah Al Balushi, Mohamed Al Rawahi
pmc-13005965.description: BackgroundThe Oman Medical Specialty Board (OMSB) Internal Medicine Residency Program addressed challenges like fatigue, burnout, and academic stress by implementing programmatic changes. These interventions aimed to improve certification exam pass rates, scholarly productivity, and work-life balance, ultimately enhancing academic performance and resident well-being within the program.

pmc-13223167.title: Humoral and cell mediated immune response to SARS-CoV-2 vaccination in patients with immune-mediated diseases
pmc-13223167.creator: Dorey A. Glenn, Yichun Hu, Meghan E. Free, Lakshmanane Premkumar, Tara M. Narowski, Grayson M. Coleman, Sandra Elmore, Mary M. Collie, Donna A. Culton, Nicole M. Orzechowski, Eveline Y. Wu, Ronald J. Falk, Donna O. Bunch, Vimal K. Derebail
pmc-13223167.description: BackgroundVaccination against SARS-CoV-2 induces an immune response that is protective against severe disease in healthy populations. However, humoral and cellular immune responses in individuals with immune-mediated diseases receiving immunosuppressive medications are not well understood.MethodsWe conducted a single-center, prospective observational cohort study of pediatric and adult patients with vasculitis, glomerular disease, or other immune-mediated diseases.

pmc-13365265.title: Comprehensive whole genome sequencing-based pharmacogenomics profiling using a personalized genome interpretation workflow
pmc-13365265.creator: Aikaterini Patrinou, Alexandros Kanterakis, Gerasimos Vonitsanos, Peter J. van der Spek, George P. Patrinos
pmc-13365265.description: IntroductionPersonalized Medicine and precision therapeutics hold promise to revolutionize modern clinical practice, by improving clinical decision making and maximizing drug efficacy, while minimizing drug toxicity, based on the unique patient’s genetic profile. Clinical decision support tools aim to help clinicians to implement genome-guided therapeutics and genomic medicine with the translation of a patient’s genomic information into a clinically meaningful format.
